title: The Long Weekend (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist Perth garden family
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The long weekend is three days and it happens about eight times a year
And every long weekend the same psychology appears
You plan too much for Friday and the Friday gets away
And Saturday is recovery and Sunday is the day

[Pre-Chorus]
Monday comes and with it the particular specific regret
That the long weekend was shorter than the long weekend you had set

[Chorus]
The long weekend knows something I don't know
It knows that three days is exactly one day more than the flow
Of normal can accommodate without the wheels coming off
The long weekend is the pressure valve the working week has bought
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The hardware store is full on the Saturday morning of the long weekend
With people who have planned a project that the weekend will lend
Itself to — and by Sunday afternoon the project's halfway
And the Monday is about accepting that particular hallway

[Bridge]
I've spent forty long weekends in the garden with a plan
That the garden absorbed partially and then the garden ran
Its own agenda and I adjusted to it and we came
To an arrangement that was neither mine nor the garden's — same

[Outro]
Long weekend knows… three days is exactly one more than enough…
That's my boy
